extraction_scope: Worker-6 final mechanism adjudication from primary results, OA figures, supplementary Table S2, and docking figure; automated placeholder mechanism labels were not promoted.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Pep-RTYM directly binds DENV particles in a peptide-virus binding assay, supporting an entry-stage antiviral mechanism.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Binding is shown in an in vitro virus-particle assay; this is not a structural-resolution binding measurement.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Pep-RTYM reduces internalized DENV RNA after early infection, consistent with inhibition of viral entry.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Pep-RTYM against DENV2 in Vero cells

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=3.2; xml:sec=3.3; xml:fig=3:Figure 3A; xml:fig=4:Figure 4A; supp:Table S2

mechanism_claims.limitations: Entry inhibition is functional and timing-based; exact receptor blockade is proposed, not directly proven.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Molecular docking predicts Pep-RTYM interaction with DENV2 envelope domain III residues near a receptor-binding region.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Docking is treated only as computational support for the entry/binding model and is not elevated to direct physical mechanism proof.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Pep-RTYM reduces DENV production in both Vero and Huh7 cells, with a weaker Huh7 effect and an internal text discrepancy over the summarized fold-reduction magnitude.
